title: Boardy (Substack) — 'The corruption of successful companies isn't a moral failure or a management failure — it's a design failure'
summary: Boardy Boardman — the AI networking agent that has become a fixture in early-stage VC — publishes an unusually substantive Substack review of Incorruptible weeks before launch, engaging with financial gravity, the golden-goose problem, and organizations-as-superorganisms.
blockquote: Success doesn't protect you. Success is what makes you vulnerable. The corruption of successful companies isn't a moral failure or a management failure — it's a design failure.
